{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"000000000000038SRTYR6EDBTF","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram @ -128,-64 flow=down box=256x128 grid=384x192
group client "Client" {
  node ReactClient "React Client" ref="packages/sdk/react-client"
  node Client "Client" ref="packages/sdk/client"
  node EchoClient "echo-client" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-client"
  node EchoApi "echo (schema)" ref="packages/core/echo/echo"
}
group host "Services (worker)" {
  node Services "ServiceStack" ref="packages/sdk/client-services"
  node EchoHost "echo-host" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host"
  node Automerge "Automerge Host" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/automerge"
  node Index "Indexing" ref="packages/core/echo/index-core"
  node Feed "Feed" ref="packages/core/echo/feed"
  node Sqlite "SQLite / OPFS" ref="packages/common/sql-sqlite"
}
group sync "Sync" {
  node Replicator "Edge Replicator" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/edge"
  node EdgeClient "EDGE Client" ref="packages/core/mesh/edge-client"
}
edge ReactClient -> Client
edge Client -> Services "services"
edge Client -> EchoClient "db proxy"
edge EchoClient -> EchoApi
edge Services owns EchoHost "spaces"
edge EchoHost owns Automerge "docs"
edge EchoHost -> Index "queries"
edge EchoHost -> Feed "queues"
edge Automerge -> Sqlite "storage"
edge Index -> Sqlite
edge Feed -> Sqlite
edge Automerge -> Replicator
edge Replicator -> EdgeClient "replicate"
edge Services -> EdgeClient "identity"
